Built for small businesses. Priced for real budgets.
landing.marquee: VeloSynq • Affordable SaaS for Small Business •

about.intro: Why should only big corporations afford the tools that make teams productive? VeloSynq gives every small business the same enterprise-grade software — at a price that actually makes sense.
paragraphs: The tools that power the world's best teams were never designed with small business budgets in mind. Per-seat pricing, annual contracts, and enterprise tiers add up fast — often into thousands every month. VeloSynq changes that equation entirely.

VeloSynq is a complete SaaS suite — SprintSynq for project management, DocSynq for team documentation, ContentSynq for content management, and ClientSynq for customer relationships. Everything your organisation needs, under one roof.

Founded in Pune by Harikrishna and Nihal, VeloSynq was born from the frustration of watching talented small business teams struggle between expensive enterprise software and inadequate free alternatives. Every business deserves access to powerful, reliable, and beautiful tools.

services.title: SprintSynq
services.description: Your affordable Jira alternative. Sprint planning, kanban boards, backlog management, and issue tracking — everything your team needs without the per-seat Atlassian bill.

services.title: DocSynq
services.description: Your affordable Confluence alternative. Team wikis, project documentation, knowledge bases, and real-time collaboration — keep your team's knowledge organised and accessible.

services.title: ContentSynq
services.description: Your affordable Contentful alternative. A headless CMS with media library, multi-channel publishing, and developer-friendly APIs — manage all your content without the enterprise price tag.

services.title: ClientSynq
services.description: Your affordable Salesforce and HubSpot alternative. Lead tracking, deal pipelines, contact management, and customer communication — a CRM that doesn't require a full-time admin.

services.title: Analytics
services.description: Business intelligence built for small teams. Unified dashboards, reports, and insights across all your VeloSynq products — know exactly what's happening in your business.

careers.title: Full-Stack Engineer
careers.description: Build and scale core product features across our React/Node.js stack. Own features end-to-end — from architecture to deployment — for products used by small businesses worldwide.

careers.title: Frontend Engineer
careers.description: Craft beautiful, performant UIs for our SaaS products. We care deeply about user experience — small businesses deserve software that's as good-looking as it is powerful.

careers.title: Product Designer
careers.description: Design intuitive experiences for tools that replace Jira, Confluence, and Salesforce. Your work will make complex workflows simple and beautiful for thousands of small business users.

careers.title: Growth & Marketing
careers.description: Drive awareness and adoption among small businesses. SEO, content marketing, paid acquisition, and partnerships — help us reach every small business that's overpaying for enterprise software.

team.name: Harikrishna
team.experience: Software engineer turned entrepreneur. Passionate about making powerful enterprise tools accessible to every business, regardless of size. Built VeloSynq to solve the problem we experienced firsthand.

team.name: Nihal
team.experience: Full-stack engineer with a vision to democratise enterprise software. Architecting the tools that small businesses deserve — beautiful, powerful, and affordable. Focused on product engineering and excellence.
